struvite precipitation is a feasible technology for recovering valuable resources from highly concentrated agro-industrial reject waters, and that the struvite crystals can be successfully used as fertilizer.
struvite recovery from highly loaded reject waters is feasible, but its efficiency and quality depend on the influent wastewater composition, particularly on the content of competing ions.

struvite is an effective tool for nutrient recovery from wastewaters, which could be a sustainable solution for nutrient management in circular bioeconomies.
